setup.title: Life Director plans your days for you
setup.body:
Tell it when you’re busy. It fits your goals into the rest. Four steps, about a minute.

Tap anywhere to continue

setup.title: Drag to set your sleep
setup.body: Move the two handles, then press Save sleep.

setup.title: Add work or school
setup.body: Anything at the same time every week. Shifts can rotate.

setup.title: Time around your day
setup.body: Getting ready, winding down, meals. Use − and +.

setup.title: Pick what to work on
setup.body: Life Director turns each goal into regular sessions. Quests are added for you.
